name: db + web — one run, two sessions, one context
description: Reads a value off a rendered page, writes it to SQLite, asserts it through SQL, and gates a browser step on a db-tagged when-condition. The page is a checked-in file:// fixture, so this needs no network and no server. Run it with: python stepper/main.py run db_web_mixed --vars "{\"page_url\": \"file://$PWD/stepper/sites/db/fixtures/inventory.html\"}"

steps.description: db: table for what the page reports

extra.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_takes (item TEXT PRIMARY KEY, on_hand TEXT)

steps.description: web: open the local inventory page
web: read the item name off the page
web: read the count off the page
db: write what the browser read — bound, never interpolated

extra.sql: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO stock_takes (item, on_hand) VALUES (?, ?)

steps.description: db: the row the browser produced is there

extra.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stock_takes WHERE item = ? AND on_hand = ?

steps.description: web: confirm, but only once the database agrees
